outcome.answer: Tannenbaum’s study finds that preceding turns can materially change AI answers: using the full conversation rather than the final message alone produced materially different answers in 44.7% of cases, while adding a compressed prefix reduced that rate to 30.8% [1]. A separate Tannenbaum study finds that the final prompt often omits request-state dimensions present earlier in the conversation, but does not estimate the causal effect of history on model answers [2].
